subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Matching headings, vocabulary development and Time to Talk
outcomes: Match headings to paragraphs using topic sentences
Find words in a text from their meanings
Use trading phrases to make a fair deal

tf.s: A topic sentence gives the main idea of a paragraph.
tf.why: Yes, it tells you what the paragraph is about.

tf.s: The topic sentence is always the last sentence of a paragraph.
tf.why: It is usually, but not always, the first sentence.

tf.s: 'Merchants' are people who buy and sell goods.
'Routes' are ways or paths from one place to another.
Paragraph 2 of the text is about the Arabs as traders.
tf.why: That is the main idea of paragraph 2.

tf.s: Knowing the part of speech can help you find a word's meaning.
tf.why: For example, 'people who buy and sell' needs a plural noun.

tf.s: 'Economic' is connected with trade, industry and money.
tf.why: Yes, economic relates to money and trade.

tf.s: 'That's a fair deal' is a phrase used to refuse a trade.
tf.why: It is used to accept a trade you think is fair.

tf.s: 'Rituals' are types of ships used for trading.
tf.why: Rituals are ceremonies or actions done in a fixed way.

boxes.q: Which word means 'people who buy and sell goods'?
Which word means 'a lot or very much'?
Complete: Frankincense was ___ to Greece, Italy and Egypt.
boxes.why: Exported means sent to other countries to sell.

boxes.q: Which word means 'a place or position'?
Which phrase can you use to start a trade?

boxes.q: What helps you match a heading to a paragraph?
boxes.why: The topic sentence shows the main idea.
It names people, and there are more than one.

boxes.q: What should you say when you accept a good trade?
boxes.why: This phrase shows you agree to the deal.

mcq.q: Which word from the text means 'people who buy and sell goods'?

mcq.why: An adverb is needed to describe 'changed'.

mcq.q: Your friend offers you his pen for your notebook, and you are happy. What do you say?
